title: Chapter 675
paragraphs: Chapter 675
Episode 172. Attempt to Captivate
Tikan, Litra Tea House.
"Jin, do you know? These days, Sandra Zipel is very happy."
Crunch!
Sandra spoke as she bit into a Litra cookie.
Hedo, sitting next to her, expressionlessly wiped the cookie crumbs from the corner of her mouth. Jin felt that they were closer to a married couple than a maid and master.
"Usually, when you hear this, it's polite to ask why they're happy."
"The fact that the word 'manners' can come from your mouth is indeed..."
"Indeed what?"
"Moving. I hope you continue to consider manners and dignity in the future."
"What are you saying, you're the one without manners from the start. These useless muscles of yours, ordinary people feel intimidated just by looking at them."
"Stop spilling your cookies. Why can't you eat without spilling, whether you're five years old or now."
"Why bother when Hedo takes care of everything?"
"Then, from today on, I should stop helping you."
"Then I'll definitely rip you to shreds!"
Jin got the impression that they were like a pair of comic actors. Listening to their conversation often made him chuckle.
"Why are you so happy, Sandra Zipel?"
"Well, it's because I've been meeting you a lot lately! Of course, you would ask that, haha."
"Hmm... I see."
Talking to a pureblood Zipel and an unidentified superhuman tower keeper about betraying Zipel.
Except for Veradin, he never imagined that he would have another day when he would have to say such things to another Zipel.
'The one holding the key is not Sandra, but Hedo.'
On the surface, Hedo was absolutely obedient to Sandra, but Jin thought that the actual control between them was held by Hedo.
Of course, Hedo usually follows Sandra's words, even if he doesn't understand them.
But there was a certain line. If Sandra made a demand that crossed that line, Hedo would never comply, and Sandra, too, would only complain and pester him, and that was it.
The ultimate decision-making power is held by Hedo.

"Every time you look so pleased, the 12th generation is casually coming and going like this. Even in a romantic relationship, sometimes the mystery of push and pull is needed. This means that Jin Lun Kendel can't find you attractive."
"Hmm... That sounds worth noting. But from what I know, Hedo has never been in a relationship. How do you know so well?"
"There are 24 hours in a day, Miss. And on average, I don't spend about five hours of that with you."
"So you used those five hours to date occasionally, tower keeper?"
Jin asked.
He was really curious. Hedo was not just the second-ranking housekeeper and tower keeper, but he also played the role of the top executive in Zipel.
If that's the case, the tasks and work to be done in the remaining five hours would be considerable, and he wondered if it was possible to date during that time.
"......Yeah. Is that strange?"
"It's a bit surprising. The position of Zipel's top executive doesn't seem as busy as I thought."
"Oh my goodness, I never thought Jin would show more interest in Hedo than me! Are you crazy, Hedo!? You're flirting like this?"
"I'm not a top executive, I'm just a housekeeper, 12th generation."
"Just a housekeeper..."
Jin's eyes narrowed.
"Then I'd like to make a job offer."
There was no need to beat around the bush.
"Great!"
Sandra immediately lit up and nodded her head, but Hedo's eyes grew sharp.
"A job offer?"
"Yes."
"Do you know what you're saying right now?"
"I know it very clearly."
"Then pretend you didn't hear it."
"Hedo, why again!"
"It's not 'why again,' Miss. Right now, the 12th generation is suggesting that we betray our family."
"So what? I've been saying we should do that."
"Miss, you might be a little confused, but this is something the 12th generation should not say. The alliance is only temporary, and Zipel and Lun Kendel are ultimately incompatible."
-It was just a few years ago in the Sota desert that Hedo almost got to me. At that time, Hedo had overwhelmed Jin and his party, but what about now?
-What are you saying?
-Can you win?
-I don't think so. I anticipated it as he rummaged through the Sword Garden alone, but seeing it up close feels different.
-See! There's definitely a possibility with Jin. I didn't think that way at first, so it's not Hedo's fault. So how about doing as I suggested last time... Oh, surprise!
The conversation between Hedo and Sandra in the Caldran Snowfield.
In fact, Sandra has been advocating Hedo to take Jin's side for a while. Hedo is strongly refusing.
"Is it just because of the long-standing grudge between Zipel and Lun Kendel?"
"Yes."
"You're not a pure-blooded Zipel, and you don't seem to have a personal grudge against Lun Kendel or the Bamel Union."
"That's right, you're not a pure-blood. I, a pure-blood, am saying that I will betray, why are you stopping me!"
"I have no personal grudge. But it seems to be developing now. Don't you think you're using the lady's affection too much?"
"Jin is not using me at all! And even if he does, what's wrong with that? I only feel good."
"It may seem that way. But this is not for the alliance or the benefit of Lun Kendel, it's considering you guys."
It was sincere.
Jin, of course, couldn't understand Sandra's feelings towards him, and even found her as a person to be mysterious.
However, after going through several incidents with her over the past few years, he developed a kind of comradeship and compassion.
Therefore, Jin was convinced that as long as Sandra remained in Zipel, her future could only be bleak.
"Sandra, move away for a moment."
"I don't want to."
"Just stay here, miss."
"I'll make dinner later, just 30 minutes."
"I'll go have a cup of tea with Enya, I'll be back!"
When Sandra disappeared, only Jin and Hedo were left in the tea house. Hedo wiped his glasses and took out a cigarette, seemingly uncomfortable.
"This is a non-smoking area."
Hedo's shirt button flew towards Jin due to his swollen muscles. Creak, Hedo lit it and burned one stick in one breath.
Grey smoke momentarily obscured the two men's vision.
"I see no reason to respect you when you cross the line."
"Understand that much. Tower Keeper, from what I see, you are not loyal to Zipel, but to Sandra Zipel."
Not Zipel, but Sandra Zipel.
He had sensed that from the first time he saw Hedo.
Although the origin of his absolute loyalty was unknown, Hedo would certainly choose the latter when he had to choose between Zipel and Sandra Zipel.
"Am I wrong?"
Instead of answering, Hedo lit the next cigarette.
"I'll take that as a yes. So, I can't understand it all the more. If Sandra Zipel continues to stay in the family, what do you think the end will be?"
"It'll be the same as now."
"I met Veradin not long ago. He lost his memories and became a biogolem sorcerer, a different person than before. I thought Sandra would also be sacrificed to the experiments and end up that way."
"Miss won't end up like that, Jin Lun Kendel."
"Is it because you are protecting Sandra Zipel?"
"Yes."
"I don't understand. The protection you speak of, does it mean tolerating all experiments to a certain extent on Sandra?"

Sandra is already a biogolem. She had gained the ability to partially use the power of time through some method, and she possessed physical abilities uncharacteristic of a magician, along with super-regeneration.
"I think that the somewhat peculiar mental state of Sandra Zipel and the experiments she has undergone are not entirely unrelated."
"Lady Sandra is originally strange. It has nothing to do with the experiments."
"Well, that's good, but is there a guarantee that it will continue to be so? If she changes like Veradin, can we really call her Sandra Zipel?"
"That's not for you to decide."

"It's not for you to decide either. It's up to Sandra herself. And what kind of protection is that, anyway? You allow experiments until a person is not completely broken, and beyond that, you'll protect her? Are you really keeping Sandra by your side with such a thought?"
"I responded to the summons to know the identity of my sword today, not to become a traitor and come to Tikan. And the experiment is......"
As if recalling something, Hedo's brows narrowed.
"......It was what the lady wanted."

"That's a cowardly thing to say. Even if Sandra wanted it, I don't think it's really right to leave her to become a test subject. Or did you decide that she needs at least that level of regeneration to protect Sandra in any situation?"
"What can you do then?"
"What?"
Hedo stood up from his seat.
"Let's say Lady Sandra betrays Zipel. What's next? Can you and the Bamel Union always prioritize Lady Sandra? Can you prioritize Lady Sandra even if the entire Union perishes?"
"Obviously not."

"You're certainly strong. Now you might be even stronger than me. But when the fight with Rosa ends and the alliance breaks, I still can't see you defeating Zipel in my eyes. Even if I join you and gain strength, it's the same."
"So you're going to bet Sandra's life on what you think has a higher possibility."
"Yes. Even if it wasn't you but Sir Shiron who proposed, I would have refused. I've said so much, I wish you would understand and give up."
"In that case, if I have the power to completely overwhelm Zipel, should I understand it as you would accept the proposal?"
Without hesitation, Hedo nodded.
"By all means. If you give me such confidence, even if you refuse, I might beg you to please accept me and the lady."
